name: Galactic Conflict
storyline: Enjoy the single player campaign where the Terran Confederation’s home planet has been attacked by the mysterious Pyros race without prior notice. Only a small fleet of Terrans could survive the cowardly attack and they are now on the run. Join the terran space fleet in 12 immersive missions, help protect the only survivors of the human race and find the best strategies to repel the invaders.
summary: Galactic Conflict brings Real-Time Strategy (RTS) on an unrivaled scale right to your iPad. Battle other players online controlling huge space fleets ranging from small fighters to gigantic battlecruisers. Play the single player campaign or train against the AI.
